intent: SensorMetricBoundary validates a sample value against its metric: HR 30-240 BPM, Power 0-2500W, Cadence 0-220 RPM, Swimming Pace strictly above 45 sec/100m (one-sided). A violation yields VALIDATION_FAILED, otherwise VALID; the payload is never dropped. Unknown metric kind is refused.

methods.semantics: metric must be one of HR, POWER, CADENCE, SWIM_PACE; otherwise IllegalArgumentException
